support_claim: Legal has not determined which registry entity is the contracting party, and the packet instructs treating the registry link as unresolved despite naming overlap between CRM and billing records.

critic.reason: The cited commercial notes establish that legal has not determined the contracting registry entity (including a separate Wyoming LLC) and explicitly instruct treating the link as unresolved, which blocks establishing same-entity or distinct legal-counterparty identity between the CRM and billing referents despite naming overlap.
